basic_info.description: This property is a jewel, It has everything you need!  Great floor plan with generous living areas.  Combo Living/Dining with hardwood floors, great windows with south facing light, track lighting and entry to large cover patio, remote screen keeps all the pests out but the views are spectacular!  Just voted the most beautiful Baseball park in the country! It is a wonderful view. Kitchen overlooks the living space with a raised bar. Newer appliances, granite countertops, great storage, gas range. Main bedroom with walk in closet and windows facing East and South.  Hall with new large washer dryer and Bathroom. Tile floor and tub surround, shower over tub.  One sink vanity with lots of storage. A small bonus room is off the living room,  Office, bedroom, Den. This 1 bedroom has it all, the space where you need it and and more. The mid century furniture, some by the original designers, and the art is for sale and negotiable also.1 garage parking and 6 storage spaces. 1 Wine locker in wine cellar.
